escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a root handoff certificate inherited from the base as if it had been generated for the current issue and pull request.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the root handoff identity against the current issue, PR, refs and exact material head before rebuilding the package.
literal_case.observed: The inherited foreign certificate was rejected and the rebuilt delivery package is bound to issue #615 / PR #671 at current material head 155344dccc4963d4915257f62f2a7b1b1e01e1ff.

prevention_change.evidence: Generate a fresh target-bound result-only handoff whenever inherited root artifacts belong to another issue or PR.

detection_change.evidence: Run delivery_target_binding against the immutable base and current target before any artifact reuse.
